assessments.reasoning: The language authors' official lua.org site identifies the resource as Lua 5.4 Reference Manual. Its introduction and design chapters were directly inspected at the registered edition URL. The independently downloaded full response SHA-256 matches the registered source revision. The opening paragraph explicitly assigns types to values and describes Lua as dynamically typed. A variable may hold values of different types over time while each value has its own type. The exact Lua 5.4 edition governs the documented rule for language variables and values. Fixed C representation and numeric build options concern implementation choices. They do not turn Lua variables into declarations with fixed types.

limitations: The claim concerns types of language values and variables, with no assertion about numeric representation in a particular build.
